text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bourses of Kuwait, Lebanon and Egypt will be linked from the first week of 1997, easing the way for investors, a stock exchange official says.
- Gulf Arab business leaders say their countries have to do more to lure private and foreign investments to help diversify their economies.
- Gulf Cooperation Council secretary arrives in Bahrain on Monday to discuss results of Gulf Arab summit held in Doha earlier this month.
